status: Ideation track 2 draft. Nothing here is decided.
stat_scale: Rulebook 1.2.5 working scale, about double Battlegrounds. Mice sit under the usual body on purpose, most of all in Health.
shared_rules: ../SHARED-RULES.md is the glossary and the rulings between tribes. Keyword spellings and reminder text here are copied from it; where the two differ, it wins.

rules.types: Voles, shrews and dormice in this list are all Mice for 'your Mice'. The second word on the type line is flavour; no card reads it. No Mouse is a Knight or a Squire (those are Badger type words).

pile_on.what: Once per fight, when a friendly neighbour attacks, this unit Ambushes the same enemy before its ordinary damage exchange, unless another Ambush source already spent its use.
pile_on.neighbour: Rulebook 8.2.3: the units next to it in its row, in front of it and behind it. Up to four.
pile_on.when: Rulebook 9.6.1 step 2. Order: the attacker's own 'whenever this attacks' effects (Fury, a Scout's Cousin), then 'whenever a neighbour attacks' effects (the Captain's Cousin), then the pile-on. A unit summoned earlier in that step can pile on.
pile_on.together: Pile-on Ambushes requested during the same attack land together. Each amount is fixed before its own after-pile-on growth; every participant spends its one use even if another would have killed the target.
pile_on.target_dies: If the target is dead after the pile-on, the attack ends there (9.6.1, last line): the attacker deals no damage and takes none, and nothing carries on by Overrun or Cleave. Its attack is used up. Death resolution (9.7) and the attacker's 'after this attacks' effects still happen. The attacker did not kill the target, so 'after this kills' effects on it don't trigger (no Medal for a Flying Ace, no extra attack for The Oakfeller).
pile_on.not_an_attack: An Ambush is not an attack: no attack or attacked hooks, Cleave or Overrun. Zero Attack does not fire or spend the use. Returns carry the spent fight count; a newly summoned Cousin is a new unit with one use.
pile_on.any_attack: It can answer any neighbour attack, including a Sortie or out-of-turn attack, but only while its one Ambush allowance remains. Windfury and golden copies add no uses.
pile_on.attacker_gone: If the attacker dies or leaves in step 1 (Thorns), nobody piles on: there is no attack left to join.
pile_on.others: Thorns and other 'whenever this is attacked' effects act on the attacker only, in step 1. A mouse that Thorns kill never gets its pile-on, so Thorns are a strong answer to mice.
pile_on.damage: Quarter Attack, rounded up, normally; half or 75% with a normal or golden Dame Bodkin. It stays smaller than full Attack and never grants additional uses.

rules.cousins: A Cousin is summoned into the empty slot nearest its source (8.4.2). With no empty slot it is lost (8.4.5); unlike a Locust Hopper it never waits.

ambush.what: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
ambush.allowance: One per unit per fight shared across Pile on, Ballista, Catapult and every Master. A return retains the spent allowance. Golden, windfury, multiple sources or multiple Masters do not refresh it.
ambush.targeting: Opening Ballista and the Master-selected unit target the lowest current Health in either row, ignoring Guard; ties are random. Catapult uses its ordinary attack target; Pile on uses the neighbour's target. All read current total Attack, including slot buffs and auras.
ambush.timing: Ballista in main Start of fight; Catapult before its first own attack; Pile on before the first neighbouring exchange it can join. The Master buffs only the leftmost back-row unit by +4 Attack this fight (+8 golden), then asks it to Ambush. A spent chosen unit is not replaced by another shooter.

keywords.Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
keywords.Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
keywords.Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.

tokens.name: Cousin
reminders: Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
tokens.implementer: Mouse token. Only ever summoned in a fight, so it lasts that fight and never reaches the recruit board. It has its slot's buff and counts as a Mouse. A Cousin with no empty slot to land in is lost (8.4.5); unlike a Locust Hopper it doesn't wait. A golden King Speck summons 4/4 Cousins. Its pile-on Ambush shares the once-per-unit-per-fight allowance and deals quarter Attack, rounded up.

units.name: Needle Page
reminders: Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.implementer: Pile on as in rules.pile_on. Works next to, behind or in front of any attacker, Mouse or not. Its pile-on Ambush shares the once-per-unit-per-fight allowance and deals quarter Attack, rounded up.

units.name: Hedgerow Scout
units.text: Whenever this attacks, summon a Cousin.
reminders: Cousin: A 2/2 Mouse with Pile on.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.implementer: A 'whenever this attacks' effect (9.6.1 step 2): the Cousin is placed before any Pile on, in the empty slot nearest the Scout (8.4.2). If that slot neighbours the Scout, the Cousin piles on in this same attack. No empty slot: no Cousin (8.4.5).

units.name: Harvest Piper
units.text: Pile on. When played: Give your other Mice +2 Attack.
reminders: Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.implementer: When played from hand (7.2.3): every other Mouse on your board gains +2 Attack permanently, on the unit. One-off; moving it does nothing. Its pile-on Ambush shares the once-per-unit-per-fight allowance and deals quarter Attack, rounded up.

units.name: Whetstone Vole
units.text: At the end of your turn, give this slot +3 Attack.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
units.splash_for: Badgers: a lone Knight's slot gains +3 Attack a turn and keeps it when the Knight is replaced; on an Armsbearer's slot it is lent to both units in front. Pigeons: more Attack on a drilled post, and their Lieutenant deals each slot's Attack buff at the start of the fight.
units.implementer: A slot buff (SHARED-RULES), Attack only, on the slot the Vole stands in when the turn ends (3.4.1). Permanent. The player moves the Vole to lay Attack on a different slot. A Pigeon Regimental Sergeant Major on the board doubles it as it is given.

units.name: Shrew Cutpurse
units.text: Pile on. The first time this piles on each fight, gain 1 gold.
reminders: Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.implementer: Its first pile-on in a fight earns 1 gold, added at the start of your next turn whether or not it survives. Any neighbour's attack will do, so it earns on any board. Each Cutpurse pays. If it returns in the same fight it doesn't earn again. Its pile-on Ambush shares the once-per-unit-per-fight allowance and deals quarter Attack, rounded up.

units.name: Thimble Captain
units.text: Whenever a neighbour attacks, summon a Cousin.
reminders: Cousin: A 2/2 Mouse with Pile on.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.splash_for: Pigeons' 'hold the post': when no Reserve unit is left to step in, a Cousin lands in the buffed slot the next time a unit around the Captain attacks. Locusts' devastation: Cousins that die pay the Gleaner and The Eighth Plague like any friendly death.
units.implementer: Triggers in 9.6.1 step 2, after the attacker's own 'whenever this attacks' effects and before any Pile on. Not on its own attacks. The Cousin goes to the empty slot nearest the Captain (8.4.2); if that slot neighbours the attacker it piles on in this same attack. No empty slot: no Cousin.

units.name: Needle Pikeman
units.text: Pile on. Can't attack. After this piles on, gain +3 Attack permanently.
reminders: Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.golden: Gains +6 Attack, still once a fight.
units.splash_for: Behind any tribe's sturdy attacker: one quarter-Attack opening Ambush and one permanent Attack gain. It is still a counted unit, not a Squire; a kill by its Ambush is not the attacker's kill.
units.implementer: Still cannot attack, but returns damage normally when attacked. After its one pile-on Ambush, gains +3 Attack permanently (+6 golden). Limit one; a Master-triggered Ambush is not a pile-on and does not pay this gain.

units.name: Toothpick Ballista
units.text: Start of fight: Ambush the enemy with the least Health.
reminders: Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.golden: Double printed stats; still one Ambush at quarter Attack.
units.implementer: Main Start of fight: one quarter-Attack Ambush of the lowest-current-Health enemy in either row. No extra golden strike. All Ambush sources share the unit allowance.

units.name: Shrew Harrier
units.implementer: Two ordinary attacks back to back on its turn, with a new target each time. Neighbours can spend Ambush on the first eligible attack only; the second attack does not refresh them. Captain summons can still answer either attack. Windfury sources do not stack.

units.name: Spoon Catapult
units.text: Before its first attack, Ambush its target.
reminders: Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.golden: Double printed stats; still one Ambush at quarter Attack.
units.implementer: Before its first own attack, Ambush that attack target once, then resolve the ordinary attack with full retaliation. Windfury or an out-of-turn attack cannot add a second Ambush.

units.name: Grindstone Miller
units.text: At the end of your turn, give this slot and its neighbours +2 Attack.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
units.splash_for: Pigeons' parade ground and Lieutenant; any tribe that keeps its best units in the middle of the board.
units.implementer: Permanent slot buffs, Attack only, on its own slot and the slots neighbouring it (8.2.3), empty or not: five slots from F2, F3 or B2, four from B1 or B3, three from F1 or F4. A Pigeon Regimental Sergeant Major on the board doubles each as it is given.

units.name: Dormouse Cook
units.text: At the end of your turn, if your board is full of Mice, give them +3 Attack.
units.implementer: End of turn (3.4.1): if all seven slots hold Mice, the Cook included, each of them gains +3 Attack permanently, on the unit. One empty slot or one unit of another tribe and nothing happens.

units.name: Fencing Master
units.text: Pile on. The first time each of your Mice piles on in a fight, it gains +3 Attack permanently.
reminders: Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.implementer: While the Master is on the board: after a friendly Mouse piles on for the first time in this fight (the Master included), that Mouse gains +3 Attack, on the unit in the fight and on the recruit board. Once a fight for each Mouse (a return doesn't reset it), so at most +21 a fight across a board. A second Fencing Master gives its own +3. A Cousin keeps it for the fight only. Its pile-on Ambush shares the once-per-unit-per-fight allowance and deals quarter Attack, rounded up.

units.name: Parish Standard-bearer
units.text: Your Mice have +2 Attack for each Mouse you have.
units.implementer: An aura (12.2.1) while it is on the board. Counts every Mouse on your board, itself and Cousins included, and is recounted whenever one arrives or dies: seven Mice have +14 each, three have +6 each. Two Standard-bearers add up. Aura Attack is borrowed: Eat, Sword-heir and Old Brock don't take it.

units.name: Master of Engines
units.text: Start of fight: Give your leftmost back-row unit +4 Attack this fight. It Ambushes the enemy with the least Health.
reminders: Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.golden: +8 Attack to the selected unit; still one shared Ambush.
units.splash_for: A high-Attack leftmost back-row unit: a Badger Armsbearer, a Pigeon on a drilled slot, or a Briar after its Grow. Place the Master later in reading order if that Grow should resolve first. Only one shooter Ambushes.
units.implementer: Main Start of fight: choose only the leftmost living back-row unit, any tribe, give +4 Attack this fight (+8 golden), then request its Ambush against the weakest enemy. If it already spent its Ambush, do not move to a different unit.

units.name: Edgewright
units.text: Start of fight: Your slots give double Attack this fight.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
units.splash_for: Pigeons: drilled slot Attack grows stronger; Lieutenant converts a quarter of the larger effective buff into temporary Health. It still stacks with give-time slot multipliers.
units.implementer: Start of fight, set-up pass (SHARED-RULES, 'Start of fight'), so it is on before any effect that reads a slot. For this fight every slot on your board gives double its Attack buff: the stored buff is unchanged and is read at twice its value, by the unit in the slot and by anything that reads a slot's Attack buff (the Pigeons' Lieutenant). It keeps working if the Edgewright dies. Health is not doubled. It stacks with the Regimental Sergeant Major, who doubles buffs when they are given. Two Edgewrights don't stack: the bigger applies (a golden one's triple). The Colour Ensign copies the stored buff, and its slot is then read double like any other.

units.name: King Speck
units.text: Whenever this attacks, fill your empty slots with Cousins.
reminders: Cousin: A 2/2 Mouse with Pile on.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.implementer: A 'whenever this attacks' effect: a Cousin goes into every empty slot on your board, placed one at a time outward from the King (8.4.2), before any Pile on.

units.name: Dame Bodkin
units.text: Pile on. Pile-on Ambushes deal half Attack instead.
reminders: Pile on: Once a fight, before a neighbour attacks, Ambush its target.
Ambush: Deal a quarter of this unit's Attack (rounded up), with no damage back. Once a fight.
units.implementer: While alive, sets pile-on Ambush damage to half Attack, or 75% golden. Does not alter opening Ballista or Catapult Ambushes. Multiple copies use the largest percentage, never extra uses.

units.name: Kettle-drummer
units.splash_for: Pigeons that fly Sorties from the back row; any tribe whose back row is more than supports. It does nothing for a Locust War-drummer, which drums only from the front row.
units.implementer: An aura on your B1–B3 units, any tribe and itself included: two ordinary attacks in a row. A Catapult still Ambushes only once per fight across both attacks and other Ambush sources. A unit that cannot attack still cannot. Extra-attack sources do not stack.
